showChatMessage.name: Show chat message
showChatMessage.hint: Show a tidbit in chat as a whisper on login

showLoadingScreen.name: Show loading screen
showLoadingScreen.hint: Show a tidbit while loading a scene

startupLoadingScreen.name: Startup Tidbit time
startupLoadingScreen.hint: Time in seconds to hide the startup Tidbit, 0 to disable

loadingScreenMinimumDuration.name: Loading screen fade out delay
loadingScreenMinimumDuration.hint: The time in seconds to keep the loading screen visible after the scene is loaded

loadingScreenGradient.name: Loading screen gradient
loadingScreenGradient.hint: Cover half of the image with a gradient to make the text more readable and apply a blur filter to the image

pauseText.name: Pause text
pauseText.hint: Show Tidbits instead of the 'Game Paused' text

customSource.name: Custom source
customSource.hint: Custom JSON file to use as tidbit source, leave empty to disable.

imageSource.name: Image source
imageSource.hint: Folder to use in loading screens, leave empty to disable.

autoCycle.name: Auto cycle
autoCycle.hint: Time in seconds after which to cycle through the tidbits in pause text. 0 to disable.

didYouKnowText.name: Did you know text
didYouKnowText.hint: Custom text to use in place of the default 'Did you know?' text.
